sentences.text: MRO Midwest Reliability Organization NPCC Northeast Power Coordinating Council RF ReliabilityFirst SERC SERC Reliability Corporation Texas RE Texas Reliability Entity WECC WECC Statement of Purpose In November 2023, the Federal Energy Regulatory Commission (FERC), NERC, and the Regional Entities participated in a joint inquiry on the December 2022 Winter Storm Elliott1 event and the report included eleven recommendations.
Two of the eleven recommendations were associated with load forecasting.

To help address the load forecasting recommendations, NERC’s Reliability and Security Technical Committee (RSTC) hosted a panel session during the September 10, 2024, RSTC meeting in Montreal, Canada.

Eight stakeholders were invited to participate in the panel session and share their strategies on load forecasting changes and improvements that they have made to address the Winter Storm Elliott recommendations.
